'''2010 Worlds Day 2 John Ferguson DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Ferguson]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
